# Magic of Discoveries

Children's coloring books, step-by-step drawing books and bedtime stories by
Ricardo Demi and Maria Demi. Published by Magic of Discoveries LLC, Miami, Florida.
Editions in English and Spanish.

## What the books are

- Coloring books for ages 1 to 3: 111 large drawings per book, thick outlines,
  one drawing per page, single-sided printing. Designed so a toddler who cannot
  yet control a crayon still produces a result that looks finished.
- Step-by-step drawing books: every subject broken into four steps starting from
  a circle or an oval, so a child can draw a recognizable animal without adult help.
- Bedtime books for ages 1 to 3 (Little Max): one or two sentences per page,
  short enough for a toddler to reach the end.
- Illustrated story collections for ages 3 and up (Lucky Rocky), based on the
  authors' own English Cocker Spaniel.
- Easy coloring books for teenagers and adults (Take a Break): 50 bold, open
  designs per book, finishable in one sitting, deliberately not intricate mandalas.

## How the books are designed

All titles follow one design rule: the child has to be able to finish the page.
Line weight, number of objects per page, story length and number of drawing steps
are each set just inside what the child can already do, because a page that gets
completed is what brings the child back the next day. The publisher calls this the
ECL approach, for emotional, creative and linguistic development, which are treated
as growing together rather than in sequence. The full framework, with age groups
and per-format parameters, is published at
https://ricardo-demi-books.vercel.app/method

The site has a section explaining this and answering common parent questions,
at /en/method and /es/metodo. Each guide ends with one specific recommended title.

## Recognition

- The Adventures of Lucky Rocky, Two-in-One Edition: winner, Adventure category,
  Children's Book International Awards 2025.
- Where Have You Been, Little Max?: finalist, Bedtime category, same awards.
- How to Draw 111: finalist, Educational category, same awards.
- The Adventures of Lucky Rocky, Two-in-One Edition: Gold Award,
  Literary Titan Book Awards 2024.
- Where Are You Going, Little Max?: Gold Award, Literary Titan Book Awards 2024.

Independent editorial reviews: Readers' Favorite and Literary Titan.

## Where to buy

Printed books are sold on Amazon and by other retailers on four continents:
Barnes & Noble and ThriftBooks in the United States, World of Books and Alibris
in Europe and the United Kingdom, Buscalibre in Latin America, Takealot in Africa.
Author listings are also on Goodreads. Some coloring titles exist as printable PDF
editions. Each book on this site has its own page listing every available format
with its price.

## A note on age labels

The age printed on a cover describes the book, not the child. The site advises
buying for what the child can already do: whether a crayon stays roughly inside
the outline, how long the child stays with one page, and whether the subject is
recognized without asking.
